name: workflow-builder
title: Flow builder
description: Full-screen workflow editor with optional nodeTypes, onConnectEdge, onConnect, isValidConnection, onConnectionRejected, validationIssues, mode="run", nodeStatus and onNodeSelect passed to FlowBuilder; codePanel passes readOnly, markers, onValidityChange, onMonacoReady and loader to an optional CodePanel (branch, parallel, sequence and worker-backed YAML examples). The app must import '@gntik-ai/flow/styles.css' once for the canvas styles. Optional nodeTypes, onConnectEdge, onConnect, isValidConnection, onConnectionRejected, validationIssues, mode, nodeStatus and onNodeSelect pass to FlowBuilder unchanged (see its branch, parallel and sequence examples). mode="run" hides Save, Publish and the saved notice, and preserves focus and node selection. Optional codePanel renders a companion CodePanel and passes all its extensions: readOnly, markers, onValidityChange, onMonacoReady and loader; run mode forces its readOnly to true. For example, WorkflowBuilderPage mode="run" nodeStatus={{step:"running"}} onNodeSelect={openDetails}; codePanel={{files,problems:[],loader:yamlLoader,markers}} uses consumer-owned same-origin YAML workers and inline schemas.
author: gntik-ai
